stories.summary: What now for Mike McDaniel? Should the Commanders or Eagles consider coaching changes? Could Jacoby Brissett or Brian Thomas Jr. get traded?

stories.summary: We have intel on Philly's three-game slide, three remaining unbeaten teams and QBs at risk of being benched.

stories.title: Bauers' epic HR rocks Dodgers, helps move Brewers one win from World Series
stories.summary: Jake Bauers hit a go-ahead two-run blast in the seventh that helped propel the Brewers to a 6-2 win over the Dodgers in Game 3 of the NLCS.

stories.title: Players-only meeting panned by Tomlin not a problem for Schottenheimer
stories.summary: A players-only meeting held by the Cowboys' defense, which has since been panned by Mike Tomlin, is a good sign for the team, according to coach Brian Schottenheimer.

stories.title: Rahm reaches separation deal with LIV, gives up rest of nine-figure contract
stories.summary: Jon Rahm and LIV Golf have reached a separation agreement in which Rahm agreed to release all of his monetary and economic claims in exchange for the return of his exclusive name, image and likeness rights and other related marks.
